backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no backend logic implemented.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing three UI enhancement features and their affected frontend files.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing key frontend files and their thematic styling for the Valentine's UI.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base theme CSS defining color variables, dark mode tokens, and base element styling.
frontend/index.html: Simple HTML shell loading the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main interactive Valentine UI with evasive “No” button and a decorative animated reveal screen when “Yes” is clicked.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and manages a backend actor based on the user’s Internet Identity state.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Internet Identity auth provider and hook handling login, identity storage, and status management.
frontend/src/index.css: Global Tailwind styling with romantic color palette, animations, and cute shadow utilities.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React entry point configuring providers and rendering the App component.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with dark mode, content scanning, custom colors, typography, animations, and extended theme settings for a styled UI.
project_state.json: Defines the project’s current state, features, and image requirements for updating the reveal page with cuter visuals and animations.
